# ex: compositeLitNeedsParen BlockStmt/CompositeLit cases (ex.go:864-872)
# Composite literal safely enclosed by:
# - a BlockStmt (via func literal body) — no if-condition ambiguity
# - an outer CompositeLit (as an element) — safely enclosed by braces
ex {
	A -> B
}
-- x.go --
package m

type A struct{ X int }
type B struct{ X int }

type S struct{ V int }

func f() {
	// BlockStmt: composite lit inside func literal body in if condition
	if func() int { return A{X: 1}.X }() > 0 {
	}
	// Outer CompositeLit: composite lit as element of another composite lit
	_ = S{V: A{X: 1}.X}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -7,8 +7,8 @@

 func f() {
 	// BlockStmt: composite lit inside func literal body in if condition
-	if func() int { return A{X: 1}.X }() > 0 {
+	if func() int { return B{X: 1}.X }() > 0 {
 	}
 	// Outer CompositeLit: composite lit as element of another composite lit
-	_ = S{V: A{X: 1}.X}
+	_ = S{V: B{X: 1}.X}
 }
